answers.core: Core already contains the code to generate colliders as part of the import process.
answers.workaround:
Have not found any way to work around it in the runtime. Only thing I can think of is compiling the map from glTF to a scene using an editor build, but I don't know how to do that.

Edit: @jgillich has provided a workout by using `create_convex_collision`/`create_trimesh_collision`, but this requires re-implementing the importer's collider creator manually.

title: Allow importing glTF at runtime with colliders
